basics.name: Martin Birkenbaum
basics.label: Senior Software Engineer
basics.summary: Senior Software Engineer with 8+ years of experience designing, building, and deploying scalable backend services and developer tooling, including GitOps-driven automation systems. Possesses end-to-end feature ownership and a passion for robust testing, efficient developer toolchains, and clean code.

work.name: Initech Corporation
work.summary: Led architecture and development of high-throughput microservices and GitOps-driven infrastructure pipelines.
highlights: Designed and implemented high-throughput Python-based event-driven microservices, processing 10M+ daily events, ensuring scalability and performance for critical systems.
Standardized containerized deployments utilizing Docker, Kubernetes, and GitOps workflows, enhancing deployment velocity and operational reliability across the software development lifecycle.
Mentored 6 junior/mid-level engineers, establishing coding standards, testing best practices, and fostering a culture of knowledge sharing and collaborative development.
Developed custom internal developer toolchains and automation that reduced CI pipeline execution times by 40%, directly impacting developer velocity and efficiency.

work.name: Hooli Inc.
work.summary: Backend engineer focused on building RESTful APIs, developer tooling, and automated deployment integrations.
highlights: Developed robust REST APIs primarily in Python/Django and TypeScript/Node.js, ensuring high reliability and maintainability for backend services.
Integrated third-party APIs and automated webhook processors, enhancing platform extensibility and supporting external developer ecosystems.
Implemented a comprehensive suite of unit and integration tests, raising code coverage from 60% to 92% and improving overall software quality and operational stability.
